Name: facilitator-override
Description: Demo Loop is mid-answer when the designated facilitator calls time. The facilitator takes the floor over the sitting holder (the one sanctioned override); a non-facilitator who tries the same is denied. No two turns overlap: Demo Loop's turn is cut where the facilitator's begins.

Events.Text: Demo Loop, go through the proposal. Chair, keep us on time.
Let me walk through all of the details of the proposal.
We are at time, so let us move to the next item.
